# dialoghelper

> Helper functions for solveit dialogs

## Modules

- `dialoghelper.solveitskill`: Read, search, edit, and manage Solveit dialogs using dialoghelper.core, including dialog/message addressing, line-numbered inspection, targeted message edits, add/update/delete/copy/paste workflows, and safe editing patterns.
- [dialoghelper.test](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/dialoghelper/test.html.md): Run dialogs' code messages through a live solveit, `nbdev-test`-style
- [dialoghelper.tmux](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/dialoghelper/tmux.html.md): Capture and inspect content from tmux sessions, windows, and panes — locally or over SSH. Useful for sharing terminal output with LLMs, debugging across multiple terminals, or monitoring long-running processes.
